policy.description: ISM policy for raw events data stream. Rolls over backing indices at 20 GB per primary shard (or 200,000,000 documents), then deletes each rolled-over index 4 hours after it rolled over, so the previous index is always kept at least that long. Deployments that never fill a shard never roll over and retain raw events indefinitely. This is a Wazuh default policy: it is restored on every restart, so do not edit it. To change retention, create a custom policy and move the existing indices to it: https://wazuh.github.io/wazuh-indexer-plugins/ref/modules/setup/retention.html#creating-a-custom-policy
